P_0x001CA9.en: Desert-raised surface dweller, pilot of the Elemental Soulgady. Finds his place only in battle, yet seeks peace his own way. Skilled at gathering intel; sometimes acts alone for it.

P_0x001EDA.en: A Holy Langran soldier. Once thought mediocre, believed to owe rank to lineage, he proved himself amid war's chaos, minimizing his own losses. Bold, yet solid tactically.

P_0x002CE3.en: A demon priest of the destruction god Sarva Volkruss. Polite but cold and merciless. Works with Shu to prep Volkruss's revival.

P_0x009F48.en: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.

P_0x00CCE5.en: President of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, daughter of ex-president Renji Isurugi (died, <L5 Campaign>). Gentle, shrewd beauty; puts profit first, picky about neither methods nor partners.

P_0x00EEB5.en: Marshal of <Earth Fed Army>. A calculating strategist, sees the big picture, accepts good and ill. Dry, but loves sake and grandkids.

P_0x00EF62.en: Chairman of <Earth Fed Army> Joint Chiefs, ranked General. Gaspard's right hand. Cautious, bureaucratic - clashed with pragmatic Norman Sley, founder of Earth Sphere Defense Committee.

P_0x00F25B.en: Upper house member, <Earth Fed Gov't> parliament. Aqua Centrum's father. Serious, doting, worries about Aqua, who ran off to join the military.

U_0x0171A6.en: A highly mobile wind <Elemental> built for hit-and-run. Standard armament trails other <Elemental>s, so weak pilots can't unlock its full power. Output is stable and its spirit accepts nearly any pilot - hence the mass-produced Gadyful. Its spirit is Soleid of the Sandstorm, a low-rank wind spirit.
